note: Both legs of Rule 5 satisfied with dated records. Export: real outbound wine shipments under HS 22041000 to Belgium (BOL 8816003, 2026-01-16), UAE (BOL 9055986, 2026-01-24) and Nepal (BOL 9780109, 2026-02-18) - declared HS 220410/220421 is correct, no correction needed. Revenue figures are consolidated company sales (domestic + export combined), not a domestic-only split - the domestic/export revenue split is in the annual report and was not retrieved here, so it is left null rather than estimated.
